data.title: Why Is HCI Important? The Bridge Between Humans and Technology
data.html_description: Why Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) is vital for safety, accessibility, and business success. Move beyond "easy to use" to "essential for life."
data.description: Every day, billions of people tap screens, talk to voice assistants, and swipe through interfaces without a second thought. When everything works, nobody notices.
